F7_01_CoverageAuditFakeData.finding: runCoverageAudit in tools/v6_commander_specialist_pipeline.ts returned hardcoded constants (2500, 2280, 1142, 618) without actual scanning.
F7_01_CoverageAuditFakeData.fix: Replaced hardcoded numbers with genuine file existence/size check; unverified stats set to null.

F7_02_SingleMapShortTrajectory.finding: D_R30 generated 21k demo steps on single map plus 14 template states for curriculum. Multi-map real data required.
F7_02_SingleMapShortTrajectory.plan: V7 multi-map data generation using 8 distinct maps and both seats.

F7_03_CurriculumZeroConsumption.finding: BC sliced at 10000, NET_A/B sliced at 12000. Fixed in commit 8274cd8 by training across full dataset with global shuffle.

F7_04_CurriculumIndexingAndFallback.finding: Scenario C placed enemy commander on friendly castle; F commanded enemy commander to attack enemy threat; G commanded enemy commander to attack itself. Target not found fell back silently to legalActions[0].

F7_05_PseudoValueSupervision.finding: Value head was trained with 0.5 weight on arbitrary heuristic labels (+0.3/-0.3, 0.1..1.0).
F7_05_PseudoValueSupervision.fix: Added --value-weight 0.0 default in python/train_spatial_resnet.py; policy-only training mode established.

F7_06_BestOverwrittenAnd4BlockTS.finding: Python train_spatial_resnet.py overwrote best checkpoint with last epoch model on final epoch. Shared train_metrics.json overwritten. TypeScript spatial_conv_net.ts only loaded/computed 2 blocks.
F7_06_BestOverwrittenAnd4BlockTS.fix: Separated out_model (best) and out_last_model; model-specific metrics path; implemented full 4-block loading and forward inference in TypeScript.

F7_07_BCFeatureIdentity.finding: V6 pipeline BC was a 4096-dim perceptron on candidate features directly, bypassing standard BC features.
F7_07_BCFeatureIdentity.remedy: Separate candidate-perceptron from standard BC schema, isolate identities.

F7_08_Metric100PercentOnZeroOpportunitie.fix: Returned null when rehireOpportunities === 0 in policy evaluation metrics.
